title: [Epic line 1] MCP ask-data (问数): a client with its own AI gets the governed answer over the open MCP door
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a coordination node under the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-18, verbatim: 「现在就改结构」. The lines are the maintainer's: 「我们有代码搭建，mcp搭建，云端搭建，，mcp问数，云端问数」; so is their order: 「代码搭建已经可用，只是优化，mcp问数优先，其次是mcp搭建」; and the cloud lines are linked, not held here: 「云端子专题和卡片开在云项目，你只是链接，而且暂时不启动」. A parent may hold 100 children; #34659 had 72 after two days, which is why it is split.

## What this line is

A person connects their own AI client to a self-hosted app and asks for a number. This line is everything that decides whether the answer comes from a governed metric, says where it came from, asks back when the word is unclear, and says so when it had to fall back or may not see a field.

**Order: first.** New dev slots go here until its queue is empty.

## What belongs here

- The ask-data skill and the text the server sends a client.
- What the dataset and record tools return: matches, candidates, the next step, the citation line, labels in the caller's language, withheld fields, and the other result members.
- Read abilities a question needs: ordering and cutting groups, latest per group.
- Dataset vocabulary: synonyms and descriptions, and the advisory for a member that has neither.

## Acceptance reading

The daily MCP ask round on the open runner (#34869), over the ten question kinds (#35113). Both live under the measurement parent.

## Not here

The product's own ask agent: that is the hosted line, linked from #34659.
